parts.text: A small wooden boat with a bright striped sail on gentle playful waves, a cheerful rainbow arcing in the sky behind. Palette: sunny yellow, sky blue, playful rainbow pastels. Delicate watercolor painting for a premium Bible-study website. ONE delicate central element only, soft translucent washes, visible paper texture, airy composition with generous breathing room. Colorful and beautiful palette as specified. ABSOLUTELY NO text, NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO human faces, no people, no human figures, no women, no children. Wide landscape composition 16:9, soft edges fading to warm cream paper.
